verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a mobile authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence never mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls. The 'Use without an account' option and logging out to stop sync only opt out of cloud code syncing, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
